==> caddy/sites/vaultwarden.caddy
# Generated by MyLab for service "vaultwarden". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

handle @vaultwarden-web {
	@vaultwarden-web-external not remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/10
	abort @vaultwarden-web-external
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20001
}
